author: N6rL
content: Pure documentation/decision work — no code. Can start immediately alongside L2 since it has no blockers. Open sub-decisions from PIPELINE.md to settle and record in ADR.md (seed ADR.md at repo root first): (1) mypy vs pyright — pick one at max strictness; (2) mutmut vs cosmic-ray for Python mutation testing; (3) Rust illegal-states convention — typestate on RawDocument? IdentityResult as sum type? Record as agent behavioral rules; (4) IPC mechanism for Python to Rust membrane — PIPELINE.md lean is file/queue drop not a live socket, settle the exact mechanism since it affects RawDocument shape in L6/L7; (5) pre-commit vs CI blocking matrix — which checks are fast-local vs full-CI vs advisory; (6) mutation testing run policy — per-push vs per-milestone-close. AC: ADR.md at repo root with 6 entries minimum, each with decision, alternatives, rationale, and any agent behavioral rules that follow from it.
